# Gita Connects

> A free canvas for studying the Bhagavad Gita: follow the threads between its 701 verses (shared themes, questions and their answers, ideas that grow from one chapter into the next), then draw your own.

Gita Connects runs entirely in the browser. No account is needed; work is saved in the browser, and signing in only syncs it across devices.

- Find: search by verse number, theme or concept, or open any of the eighteen chapters, and put a verse on the canvas.
- Connect: one click fans out the verses it is linked to. There are 1,057 curated links, each with a type (thematic, progression, goal, question and answer, contrast, parallel, sequential, dependency, definition, illustration), a strength from 1 to 10 and a one-line reason.
- Keep: add notes, save networks, and export them as PNG or PDF.
